# M1-05 — Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs) & Acceptance Criteria

## Labels
`docs`, `milestone-1`, `priority-critical`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] Identify relevant quality attributes (security, performance, usability, availability, maintainability, etc.)
- [ ] Assign each NFR a unique ID (e.g. NFR-001)
- [ ] Make each NFR specific and measurable (avoid "the system must be fast/secure")
- [ ] Record source/driver and priority for each NFR
- [ ] Write acceptance criteria / verification approach for each NFR
- [ ] Explain how at least one NFR could constrain an M2 architecture or technology choice
- [ ] Add NFRs into PED v1.0 and link into the RTM

## Acceptance Criteria
- NFRs are quantified where practical (e.g. response time, uptime target, password policy) not just labelled.
- Each NFR has ID, description, measurable criterion, source, and priority.
- Team can show one NFR and explain its downstream effect on architecture/technology decisions (defence Q3).
